# Define candidate transform based on demo: copy the special-color shape wherever its footprint is all background zero.
from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    cells = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells}
    mh=max(r for r,c in shape); mw=max(c for r,c in shape)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-mh):
        for c in range(w-mw):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=marker
    return out
